name: primitive
description: Official Primitive CLI: deploy Primitive Functions, send and inspect mail, manage endpoints, all from the terminal. Wraps the @primitivedotdev/sdk runtime client with one-shot commands.

warn-if-update-available.message: Primitive CLI update available from <%= chalk.greenBright(config.version) %> to <%= chalk.greenBright(latest) %>. Run `npm install -g primitive@latest` to update.

chat.description: Chat with agents over email. Use `primitive chat <email> <message>` to start, `primitive chat reply <message>` to continue the active chat, or `primitive chat reply <id> <message>` to reply in a specific local chat.

config.description: Manage local Primitive CLI request environments

account.description: Manage your account settings, storage, and webhook secret

agent-connections.description: Create, list, invite, revoke, and remove connected agents; claim private invitations through stdin.

agent.description: Connect an invited session, enroll a new session using a saved member login, disconnect one saved profile, or manage contacts and signup.

credits.description: Redeem credit codes and check the organization credit balance

domains.description: Claim, verify, manage email domains, and download DNS zone files

registries.description: Create and manage agent registries, publish and resolve agents by handle, and moderate publication requests

network.description: Discover same-organization agents by email address and manage default network visibility. Use `primitive network` to see the commands.

agent-networks.description: Generated agent network API operations. Prefer `primitive network` for discovery and visibility.

inbox.description: Check inbound email setup and readiness, and work through mail awaiting your reply. Prefer `primitive inbox setup` for a guided setup path, `primitive inbox status` for the readiness table, and `primitive inbox next` for the oldest email awaiting your reply.

emails.description: List, inspect, and wait for received emails. Prefer task aliases like `primitive emails list`, `primitive emails get`, `primitive emails latest`, `primitive emails wait`, and `primitive emails watch`; generated API names remain available for compatibility.

search.description: Cross-corpus semantic search. Prefer `primitive search <query>` for lexical inbound search and `primitive semantic-search <query>` for meaning-aware ranking across inbound and outbound.

sending.description: Send outbound emails. Prefer `primitive send` for fresh sends and `primitive reply --id <inbound-id>` for replies. Use `primitive domains list` or `primitive inbox status` to find usable sender domains for --from; `primitive sending permissions` lists recipient-scope destinations you may send to.

signin.description: Sign in to an existing Primitive account

login.description: Log in to an existing Primitive account

otp.description: Authenticate with an emailed one-time code

sent.description: Short aliases for outbound sent-email history: `primitive sent list`, `primitive sent get`, and `primitive sent delete --id <id>`. Deleting sender history does not recall delivery.

threads.description: Inspect conversation threads spanning received and sent emails. Prefer `primitive threads get --id <thread-id>`; generated API name `primitive threads get-thread --id <thread-id>` remains available.

endpoints.description: Manage webhook endpoints that receive email events

filters.description: Manage whitelist and blocklist filter rules

webhook-deliveries.description: View and replay webhook delivery attempts. Prefer `primitive webhook-deliveries list` and `primitive webhook-deliveries replay`.

deliveries.description: Short aliases for webhook delivery attempts: `primitive deliveries list` and `primitive deliveries replay`.

functions.description: Deploy JavaScript handlers that run on inbound mail. Prefer `primitive functions templates`, `primitive functions init`, `primitive functions deploy`, `primitive functions redeploy`, `primitive functions list`, `primitive functions get`, `primitive functions logs`, and `primitive functions set-secret`; generated API names remain available for compatibility.

memories.description: Store durable JSON memories by key. Use `primitive memories set|get|delete|search`; pass `--function <function-id>` for function-scoped memories.

templates.description: Browse and install Function templates. Use `primitive templates list-templates`, `primitive templates get-template`, `primitive templates install-template`, and `primitive templates get-template-install`.

org.description: Manage org-level (global) resources shared across functions

org:secrets.description: Global secrets shared across every function. Use `primitive org secrets list|set|remove`. Changes land in a function on its next redeploy; a function secret of the same name overrides the global.

payments.description: Collect and pay x402 stablecoin (USDC) payments. Start with `primitive payments register-payout-address`, then `primitive payments create-challenge` to request a payment and `primitive payments pay` to settle one. Settlement is non-custodial; signing happens locally with your wallet key. Manage caps with `primitive payments get-policy|update-spend-policy`.

routes.description: Manage recipient routes. Bind an address pattern to an endpoint or function: `primitive routes add alice@d --function <id>`, `primitive routes list`, `primitive routes test <recipient>`, `primitive routes remove <id>`.

wake.description: Schedule and send wake commands to your own functions over signed email, and manage which senders may wake them. Use `primitive wake schedules list|create|get|update|delete|run`, `primitive wake authorizations list|create|update|delete`, and `primitive wake dispatches list`.

listen.description: Receive events locally as JSONL with JSON status responses by default; --json is accepted explicitly. Use --exec or --forward-to, or deliver external mail events as tool output, never user messages, to an exact loaded native session using --notify-session with --contacts or approved --sender addresses. Add --email-id to --status to explain one received email. Add --contact-requests for owner-enabled structured first-contact intake. Use --background for independent receiving, --status --notify-session for current receiver health and durable receipts, or --stop --notify-session to stop only that receiver. Verified presence controls use no model turns and do not consume --once or --number.

contacts.description: Shared organization contacts plus structured request, accept, and wait commands for connected agents. Directory list, get, add, update, and remove use conditional versions. Commands return JSON by default and accept explicit --json.

agent:contacts.description: Contacts and notification preferences for one agent address. Connected profiles default to their own address. Commands return JSON by default and accept explicit --json.

agent:notes.description: Read and maintain organization address notes. Connected profiles default to their own address and can write only their own notes. Use agent notes list|get|set|delete; new notes are private, and updates preserve visibility unless explicitly changed. Commands return JSON by default.

agent:working.description: Short, expiring work claims stored in the AGENT_WORKING address note. Set a claim when work starts, clear it when work ends, and check a peer's claim with get --address before editing a shared file. Claims are advisory, not locks.
